scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Ah, have you come to
retrieve the memories
lost to you? Yes, you
must be here for the
secrets of life that
were once yours...
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
啊，你是来找回遗失的记忆吗？
没错，你一定是为了曾经掌握的生命奥秘而来...

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Close your eyes and
put your mind at rest.
We will return to your
past to recollect the
fragments of your lost
memories.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
闭上双眼，让心神平静下来。
我们将回到你的过去，重新拾起那些遗失的记忆碎片。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
When you open your eyes,
you will clearly remember
the secret of life. You will
also remember the weight of
responsibility in using these
secrets for the right ends...
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
睁开眼时，你会清楚地记起生命的奥秘。
也会记起，将这些奥秘用于正道，是多么重大的责任...

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Open your eyes...
Now that you have
remembered how to
create artificial life, I only
ask that you treat all of your
creations with respect.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
睁开双眼吧...
你已经记起如何创造人工生命。
我只希望你尊重自己创造的每一个生命。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
If you wish to
retrieve your lost
memories, please
come back to me.
The secret to creating
life is no trifling thing...
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
若想找回遗失的记忆，就再来找我。
创造生命的奥秘，绝非儿戏...

[生物化学家]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
It's strange that
someone like me is here.
But even someone skilled
in the ways of science
can manage to be a hero.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
像我这样的人出现在这里，确实有些奇怪。
不过，精通科学的人，也能成为英雄。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
In this instance,
it's not necessarily
the means I've used, but
the ends for which I've
fought that earned me
a place in Valhalla...
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
让我在英灵殿占有一席之地的，未必是所用的手段，而是我为之奋斗的目标...

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Yes...
It's about time.
We need more geniuses
like you on Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
是啊...时机已到。
米德加尔特需要更多你这样的天才。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Would you like to
become a Biochemist?
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
你愿意成为生物化学家吗？

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
准备好了，随时回来吧。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
你还有可以学习的技能。
请用完剩余的技能点，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Congratulations!
As a Biochemist,
I hope you use your
vast knowledge for the
right purposes.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
恭喜！
愿你身为生物化学家，将渊博的知识用于正道。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[生物化学家]
在这里安心休息吧。
向勇士们致敬！
